metadata.description: Official collection of GitHub Copilot skills for Crestron AV and smart home development

skills.name: android-string-translator
skills.description: Translates Android strings.xml files into multiple locales with marker-based incremental updates, brand-name exclusion, and QA back-translation.

skills.name: crpc-test-client
skills.description: Used for testing Crestron Home CRPC requests and responses. Use this to get information about or confirm the format of a specific CRPC request.

skills.name: example-skill
skills.description: A starter example showing how to write a Copilot skill for Crestron AV and smart home systems.

skills.name: hello-world
skills.description: A test skill that responds with Hello World. Used to validate the auto-update pipeline.
